description: Koog 1.3.0 AIAgent with one simple tool, traced by Koog's OpenTelemetry feature with a synchronous span processor and verbose content.
notes: Koog puts random ids in span names (create_agent <session-uuid>, invoke_agent <uuid>), masked by volatile_name_prefixes, and in four attribute keys, masked by volatile_attributes: gen_ai.agent.id is a session UUID, gen_ai.conversation.id a conversation UUID, koog.event.id a per-span event UUID, and koog.node.output embeds the model response's wall-clock metaInfo.timestamp on the two LLM nodes (the key is masked everywhere, so the deterministic node passthroughs are masked too).
